context.body: A voice beside the Jordan · parallel witness · Matthew 3:1–6
context.label: A voice beside the Jordan

observations.body: John announces the near Kingdom, is linked to Isaiah’s voice, lives plainly, and baptizes people confessing sins in the Jordan.
observations.label: John preaches and baptizes in Judea’s wilderness

observations.body: The passage presents Preaching, confessing, and baptizing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Preaching, confessing, and baptizing

payload.posture: Read Matthew 3:1–6 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states john announces the near Kingdom, is linked to Isaiah’s voice, lives plainly, and baptizes people confessing sins in the Jordan. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
payload.title: John preaches and baptizes in Judea’s wilderness
